product_metadata.title: Paula Deen Riverbend Nonstick Dish/Casserole Pan, 13.75 Inch, Red Speckle
features: BIG PAN FOR BIG MEALS: Extra-wide and large-capacity casserole pan, perfect for one-dish meals, big batch cooking, and other dishes
EASY CLEANING PERFORMANCE: Dishwasher-safe aluminum nonstick jumbo pan heats quickly and evenly for efficient cooking and frying performance
TOP NOTCH NONSTICK: Casserole pan interior features top-quality nonstick so cooking won’t bind and cleanup is a cinch
SOUTHERN CHARM: Big casserole pan features colorful stain-resistant speckled porcelain exterior inspired by classic enamelware for a warm, cozy touch to the kitchen
ONE POT MEALS: Dutch oven styled casserole pan features large capacity for one pot meals and is suitable for all stovetops except induction
description: One-dish and large-batch cooking convenience gets upsized in style with the dishwasher-safe Paula Deen(r) Riverbend Aluminum Nonstick 10-Quart Covered Family Gathering Pan. Even occasional cooks can appreciate this large-capacity casserole pan from Paula Deen(r). Wide and big enough to hold 10 quarts, the covered pan is ideal for pulling together your favorite one-dish pasta dinner, sauteing a sizable batch of healthy veggies, or taking a tamale pie from stovetop to oven. The dishwasher-safe aluminum construction heats quickly and evenly for better cooking control whatever the recipe. And the interior features long-lasting, top-quality nonstick, so foods release in a jiffy and cleanup is a cinch. Gather family and friends around the foods you love and love to cook with this tabletop-suitable covered Dutch oven styled pan from Paula Deen(r). Suitable for all stovetops except induction, the casserole pan is conveniently oven safe to 350°F, making it easy to tackle Paula’s delicious stove-to-oven recipes. Best of all, durable, stylish Paula Deen(r) Riverbend Cookware makes mealmaking easier and conveniently leaves cleanup to the dishwasher. Explore the wide world of delicious, flavorful big-batch cooking with the colorful, charming dishwasher-safe Paula Deen(r) Riverbend Aluminum Nonstick 10-Quart Covered Family Gathering Pan.
